alex: Running rollback script now — restoring route assoc and reapplying IAM module pin. Script below: 
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# restore previous association and IAM module version
aws ec2 replace-route-table-association --association-id $ASSOC_ID --route-table-id rt-abcdef12
# ensure we don't leave half-managed resources in state
terraform state rm module.network.aws_route_table_association.private-rt || true
terraform apply -target=module.iam -var="module_version=v1.12" -auto-approve
```

deploybot: Rollback completed: restored previous route table association and reapplied IAM module v1.12. No incidents auto-opened.
